customManagers.description: Track the zizmor version pinned in security.yml's `uv tool install`. It is installed via uv at run time, so neither the github-actions nor any package manager sees it.

packageRules.description: Hold the MSRV job's Rust toolchain at the DECLARED minimum (Cargo.toml rust-version = 1.96). ci.yml's `build (MSRV 1.96)` job exists to prove the crate still builds on that floor; letting Renovate track it toward stable silently stops verifying the MSRV. Bump it only alongside a deliberate rust-version raise. (scratchsmith is the only repo in the fleet with a pinned MSRV job; siblings track stable.)

Supply-chain cooldown: soak every update for 3 days before it may merge (auto-merges included), so a freshly-published or yanked release can't land the same day it appears — fitting for a supply-chain tool. Security fixes stay immediate via the shared default's vulnerabilityAlerts (minimumReleaseAge: null).
